title: File:Biodiversity at Monthathan Waterfall, Chiangmai, Thailand.jpg
claims: The photograph shows Monthathan Waterfall in Doi Suthep-Pui National Park: a multi-tiered waterfall over dark rock, dense green forest, a wet rock ledge in the foreground and three orange butterflies resting on the stone.

Commons titles the file Biodiversity at Monthathan Waterfall, Chiangmai, Thailand.jpg; the picture documents the waterfall and its immediate biodiversity, not the 2026 A16 aid station, course markings, timing mat, runners or race-day conditions.

The author is ศุภฤกษ์ลายประวัติ; the file is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0; the photograph was taken on 2026-06-28 at 10:25:13; the original is 2,400 x 1,600 pixels and 3,189,393 bytes; the file page gives no camera coordinates.
